title: Full-site visual QA перед production cutover

source.homepageVisualBaseline: Главная утверждена Александром; переносимые паттерны используются как baseline для остальных страниц.
source.followUpCommitScope: FSVQA-01 compilations index implemented from owner feedback on live staging review.

homepagePatternsToReuse: синий CTA-strip с понятным primary action
единая типографика, gutters, rounded cards, blue accent system
mobile/tablet правила: без horizontal overflow; hero/media ratios по утверждённым компонентам
интерактивы проверять поведением, не только CSS

visualFindings.summary: Блог and Новости remain placeholder-style index pages and do not yet reuse the rich approved homepage card/list patterns. Подборки was promoted to a filled two-column compilations index in this PR follow-up.
visualFindings.expected: Use approved homepage design language: section hero, meaningful cards/list blocks, blue CTA, consistent spacing, and public-ready page depth.
visualFindings.productionImpact: blocks production visual approval until remaining index pages are accepted or fixed

visualFindings.summary: Robot detail pages are technically stable and readable, but they use an earlier detail-page visual language; should be reviewed for alignment with the newly approved homepage patterns before launch.
visualFindings.expected: Preserve approved RobotPage mobile 1:1 media rule, but align spacing/card/CTA rhythm with homepage where appropriate.

visualFindings.summary: Legal and 404 pages are functional and branded, but visually minimal compared with the approved homepage system.
visualFindings.expected: Keep legal text readable; optionally add approved shell/CTA/footer rhythm for launch polish.
visualFindings.productionImpact: non-critical, but should be accepted or improved explicitly

approval.visualApprovalScope: full site screenshots/contact sheets and findings package

resolvedFindings.ownerFeedback: Страница была пустая; нужно расположить сами подборки как блок на главной, карточки немного изменить, две колонки, текстовый блок с заголовком внизу, CTA внизу.
resolvedFindings.implementation: Replaced placeholder page with filled compilations index: 4 compilation cards from approved homepage data, desktop two-column wide card grid, bottom text block with heading, approved homepage CTA component, live-site-inspired page rhythm.
resolvedFindings.safetyBoundary: No production deploy, DNS, production secrets, analytics IDs/cookies, or live lead routing changes.
